---
name: Monthly content proposal
about: Propose a small original piece for a future DOS disk magazine
title: "[YYYY-MM] Piece title"
labels: content
---

**Piece and reader experience**
What can someone play, watch, read or learn? Link a small working slice.

**Target and budget**
8088/Tandy, graphics/text mode, free RAM/stack/buffers and disk allocation.

**Controls and safe return**
Explain Escape/retry/skip, child directory/video/cursor restoration, sound and
any timer/vector ownership. Make additions fun rather than merely harder.

**Source, assets and rights**
Actual author/tool credits, complete source/build recipe, every asset/dependency
license and references. No proprietary compiler/OS, private media or historical
program payloads.

**Evidence and limits**
Host/emulator/hardware tests, exact hashes, failure boundaries, native-resolution
readability and known unqualified behavior.
